heading: What goes in this folder
release: This list is what ART needs to build {release}.
intro: ART wrote this file because somebody asked it to. It is a list, not an instruction: put whatever you have of it in this folder and ART will work out which file is which by reading the files themselves, not by their names. Names are only what ART expects to see, and a file you renamed is still recognised.
noDownloads: ART does not download any of this and never will. Where each item came from is written under it; you go and get it, and ART reads what you already have.
filenamesUnknown: Expected file names: ART has no name recorded for this one. It is identified by its contents.
provenanceUnknown: Where it comes from: ART has no note of it.
needsNothing: Nothing has to be in place before it.
withoutRequired: Without it: the build cannot be made at all.
withoutOptional: Without it: the build is made without this part, and nothing else fails.
footer: This file is ART's, not yours: nothing reads it back, and deleting it changes nothing. Ask again for a fresh one after you change which release you are building.
